summary: AGI Inc, a Brazilian bank listed on the NYSE under AGBK, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release (Exhibit 99.1) for the period ended September 30, 2026, with the corresponding US equivalent being a domestic issuer's quarterly earnings current report. The release disclosed 8.3 million active customers (up 29% year-over-year), fee revenue of R$244.1 million, gross credit origination of R$10.2 billion, a R$38.8 billion loan portfolio, and net income of R$276.0 million. It also referenced a previously announced buyback of up to three million Class A shares over one year, disclosed October 27, 2026; no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor were stated.
